title: How Time Passes In GTA 6 And All Missable Content
description: Let’s face it: You will get distracted often when playing Grand Theft Auto 6. One moment you’re on your way to start a mission, and the next you’re scouring the world for collectibles or tailing a high-end vehicle that you want to hijack. You might be curious as to how time passes in the game, and whether there are certain activities and content that you might miss out on. Time advancement and campaign progression in Grand Theft Auto 6 You can check the current time in-game by opening the menu and looking at the upper-left corner of the screen. That said, time does advance at a fast rate in GTA 6--i.e. roughly one minute in-game for every five seconds in the real world. However, if you’re in the middle of a mission, time passes at a slower rate and, in some cases, the whole system has scripted triggers. Here are some examples: Let’s say one part of a mission has you engaged versus dozens of enemies. As you move to the next area/objective, you might notice that no time has elapsed. Some missions transition from one period to another, such as sequences that take an entire day or night. Moreover, playing JoySystem games seems to slow down time as well. For one thing, we did a fresh playthrough of Tenebrae Lux just as Jason started his day. By the time we finished, it was still 10:30 a.m. How to advance in-game time If you simply want to advance time in-game, then all you need to do is sleep in a safehouse. You can choose to wake up in the morning, at noon, in the evening, and late at night. This is useful if certain missions can only be tackled during a particular period (more on this concept later). How time affects workout windows How time passes in GTA 6 certainly impacts the improvement of your characters’ stats. That’s because of workout windows. You improve your strength and stamina by lifting weights, hitting punching bags, and exercising. Once the meter has been filled up, that stat’s level permanently increases. But this facet also has a temporary restriction…

title: All JoySystem Video Games In GTA 6

Initially, you might want to run a couple of missions, steal a few cars, or fly around in a fighter jet. Don’t let that fool you because it’s one of the coolest video games in GTA 6. With its creepy atmosphere and mind-bending puzzles, you’re bound to spend hours just trying to reach the lighthouse to discover the secrets within. We’ve got all the details for you in our Tenebrae Lux puzzle solutions guide. Street Trash III: Dezombifier Street Trash III is an isometric zombie apocalypse shooter with roguelike mechanics. Aside from watching over your health and stamina, you also need to grab power-ups that boost your XP. Each time you level up, you’re able to select from various perks. title: Hacker Threatens To Leak Free Version Of GTA 6 In Crypto Grift
description: Somehow, Cyberleek, the notorious hacker behind multiple Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks, has returned. This time, the infamous leaker is threatening to release the executable file for a working build of the Xbox version of the game hosted on their site, provided the public helps raise their meme coin to a $15 million market cap. "It is done. CL holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto 6, and it is going out by torrent," a statement from Cyberleek reads (via Kotaku ). "Now. Every file except one--the main executable--held on a countdown. Honest terms, as always: it is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build. CL does not care. This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps. CL told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons." The files on Cyberleek's site reportedly clock in at over 200GB, which would line up with the Xbox version of the game, but there's no guarantee they're the actual GTA 6 data or a collection of malware waiting to be downloaded onto a PC. The hacker added that if their demands aren't met, they'll release the executable needed to play GTA 6. However, there's no guarantee the game can be emulated, and Cyberleek added that they'll "work to get a PS5 build" if people keep supporting them. This isn't the first time Cyberleek has threatened to release a pirated build of GTA 6; back in October, they promised to do so if their meme coin reached $30 million in value. While this didn't happen--and the coin eventually crashed out--they did drop several GTA 6 video clips throughout the month showing off more of the game in action. While Cyberleek initially claimed to act in gamers' interests when they first burst onto the scene, they true motives were quickly revealed when they started hyping up their meme coin-- reportedly part of a pump-and-dump scheme. While Cyberleek has yet to be identified, their actions did lead to GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games to issue a statement, in which it described the leaks…

title: GTA 6’s Console Wars Are Already Over, And Xbox Lost
description: Grand Theft Auto games have never shied away from satirizing life, and GTA 6 has plenty of digs at famous brands, trends, and people. Not even gaming is immune to GTA's patented satire, especially if you're playing on Xbox, because there's no escape from PlayStation — or its legally distinct cousin, the JoySystem. Early in GTA 6, you'll get to bond with Jason's best pal, Cal. After maximizing the energy of Jason's bachelor pad with a little feng shui redecorating, the duo settles in for a night of booze, drugs, and video games on Booby's JoyStation console, which looks very similar to a PS5. It looks like this is the only gaming hardware in Leonida, since there are no Xbox Egg-Cube Stations X to play games on. The JoySystem isn't just for decoration either; after you've hung out with Bobby, you can return and play games on it. You can choose between an avant-garde experience or more immediate gratification with a pair of shooter games, and it's impressive how good these three games are on their own. From top-down action to stunning mystery that pokes fun at auteur-driven games, they're worth checking out. The JoySystem interface is also a 1:1 copy of the PS5 user interface, with the exact same layout for games and other apps — but given how much Sony is making from GTA 6 sales, we're guessing the company sees it as a cheeky little homage. But the controllers for the console? They look terrible: Eww. In real life, PS5 sales have absolutely dominated GTA 6 preorders and sales. Video game research company Sensor Tower estimates that GTA 6 sales have reached 24.58 million total units via pre-purchases and copies sold at launch, which works out to about $2.36 billion in gross revenue. Of that number, 18.44 million units are said to be PS5 copies of the game, of which Sony will get a 30% cut of sales. For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub.

title: GTA 6 Has Aliens, And Here’s How To Find Them
description: The truth is out there! Unidentified Flying Objects are once again whizzing around in Grand Theft Auto 6, but compared to previous games, you can have a close encounter of the third kind this time. So far, two distinct UFO mysteries have been revealed in GTA 6, and if you're looking to meet visitors from another world, here's how you can find them. Alien encounter 1: The abduction Once you've completed Chapter 1 of GTA 6, you'll want to head northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 AM. Make certain that you are alone. While you're on the road, keep an eye out for a stranded vehicle with flashing headlights. The car will be pointing to a trail that leads into the woods, and you can follow it to see an eerie blue light in the distance. Once you're close enough, the UFO will stop abducting a local woman, and she'll ask you to go fetch her car for her. Offer to help her, and once you get her vehicle, Jason or Lucia will be abducted by the aliens. This will unlock the "The truth is out there" achievement/trophy. Alien encounter 2: Area 51 As the character who was abducted, they'll have a vivid dream sequence during their sleep, after some time has passed. During the dream sequences, keep track of the lines above the keypad, as this will form a code (usually it's 2134 ). This while sequence will prepare you for the alien retrieval mission that lies ahead, with glimpses of where to go and what to do. At South Point Airfield in Hamlet, look for the radio tower. While it is fenced off, a part of the fence can be climbed on the left side. Next, climb to the roof of the building using the ladder on the far side and enter the open hatch Go downstairs and enter the code " 2134 " on the keypad (it's marked on the wall to the left). Take the elevator to the basement. As you explore the area, you'll eventually make your way to a control room where you can listen to a tape about why aliens abduct so much cattle Press the buttons on the control panel until all lights…

title: All WAiNK Curiosities In GTA 6
description: Grand Theft Auto 6, much like its predecessors in the hit series, is chock-full of strange and mysterious happenings. One activity, in particular, has you scrounging the state of Leonida in search of odd stuff. Some of these just look a bit off, while others seem as though they don’t even belong in our world. If you manage to scan these using your app, they can be tallied as part of your WAiNK Curiosities collection. For the sake of clarity, we’ve numbered these locations starting with those near Jason’s home, followed by those to the south and west, and then the ones near the swamplands to the north. WAiNK Curiosity #1: Christmas House If you drive along the westernmost street in Key Lento, you’ll see a house that’s in a festive mood. Maybe the homeowners are Filipinos who tend to celebrate Christmas early? title: All WAiNK Landmarks In GTA 6
description: There are a total of 31 WAiNK Landmarks in Grand Theft Auto 6. Similar to other related points-of-interest, these structures dot the towns and counties of Leonida, and you have to keep your eyes peeled if you want to find all of them. In This Article WAiNK Landmarks in Mariana County WAiNK Landmark #1: Badger R&D Tower WAiNK Landmark #2: Thicc Herbie WAiNK Landmark #3: Riquezas Key Radome WAiNK Landmarks in Mariana County If you want to scan these WAiNK Landmarks in one go, you can drive from Jason’s home while heading to the southwestern tip of the zone. WAiNK Landmark #1: Badger R&D Tower This one’s fairly hard to miss as it’s a large radio tower along the main avenue. It’s due south of Brian’s Marina in Key Lento. WAiNK Landmark #2: Thicc Herbie Speaking of Brian, one of the early-game missions that you tackle for him is called “Hey, Arnold.” That takes you to a meeting point in Maroon Key, which happens to have a huge blimp structure. Curiously enough, we weren’t able to scan the blimp at that point. We later realized that this GTA 6 WAiNK Landmark can only be scanned from Abismo Key State Park, which is well across the waters to the south. WAiNK Landmark #3: Riquezas Key Radome Keep going south-southwest past Mile Zero Air Station until you reach Riquezas Keys. The radome is at the southern tip of the island. We’ll keep you posted in case we discover other WAiNK Landmarks in the game. For now, though, you can take a look at our Sculpture locations guide and Curiosities locations guide. You’re going to feel lost as you explore the cities, beachfronts, and seedy underbelly of Leonida. title: All WAiNK Sculptures In GTA 6
description: The vistas of Leonida in Grand Theft Auto 6 have their fair share of artworks and architecture made by skilled craftsmen. In the same vein, there are also unique WAiNK Sculptures found in various locations. All of these can be scanned using the trusty WAiNK app on your phone. WAiNK Sculpture #2: Fatal Incursion Plaque If you keep driving to the southwestern tip of Key Lento--i.e. past the barber shop and clothing store--you’ll see something that looks like a memorial by the beachside park. WAiNK Sculpture #3: Triangler Sculpture Another task that Brian wants you to do is to “Go See Cal.” The meeting place just northeast of Jason’s house. title: All Magazines, Books, And Comics In GTA 6
description: Fancy spending some time reading stuff in Grand Theft Auto 6? There are plenty of magazines, books, and comics for you to find in the game. Some offer insights about life in Leonida, while others are humorous jabs and general whimsy. There are even ones that offer additional information, with points-of-interest that get marked on your map. Magazines, Books, and Comics in Mariana County The first major zone in the game, Mariana County, has several reading materials for you to discover. In fact, a bunch of them can be found inside Jason’s home. Note: We don’t want to spoil all the details, but make sure you read all the books and mags in Jason’s home before the end of Chapter 1. Magazines, Books, and Comics #1 to 5 You can find the following in Jason’s house: Lethal By Design - On the coffee table in the living room. Orca: A Whole Different Animal - On a desk next to a radio and a stack of books. Ashes of Glory - On the bedside table. Body Copy - On a table at the back porch next to the workout area. Reel Talk - Inside the shed underneath the house. Magazines, Books, and Comics #6: RX-Men Go to the 24/7 convenience store due east of the main thoroughfare in Key Lento. This spoof of the X-Men is on the magazine rack. These are just some of the GTA 6 magazines, books, and comics that we’ve found while exploring. We’ll update this guide when we spot others, so stay tuned. For now, assuming you’re also searching for other collectibles, we encourage you to read our Underwater Discoveries/Kenton’s Treasures guide. Likewise, there are dozens of objects that you can scan using the WAiNK app. These include Sculptures, Landmarks, and Curiosities. title: How To Retrieve All Lost And Damaged Cars In GTA 6
description: It goes without saying that, at some point, you're going to lose, damage, or destroy your favorite car in Grand Theft Auto 6. It's a rite of passage in the GTA world, and with how fragile some vehicles can be in Leonida, you're going to need to retrieve your car at one time or another. However, sometimes losing a car or motorcycle is out of your control, especially if you're doing story missions or side content. GTA 6 will often remove your vehicle from the map or replace it with another, leaving you wondering how to get your previous vehicle back. Whether your vehicle's been replaced, lost, damaged, or destroyed, we have you covered with all the methods to retrieve it in GTA 6. In This Article All ways to retrieve a lost vehicle in GTA 6 Scooter Bros App Look in Garages Check impound lots Register vehicles All ways to retrieve a lost vehicle in GTA 6 There are a few different ways to get a lost vehicle back in GTA 6. It can depend on how you lost the vehicle, but for the most part, the methods will be the same regardless of what happened to your ride. A small disclaimer first, though, is that you'll need to progress past Chapter 1 to start owning vehicles in GTA 6. During Chapter 1, you have to solely rely on Jason's car, boat, and motorcycle to get around the map unless you steal a vehicle, and in this chapter, you can't own stolen vehicles. Once you get to Chapter 2 and beyond, you'll be able to start using the vehicle retrieval methods we'll talk about below. However, if you're in Chapter 1 and happen to lose or destroy one of Jason's vehicles, your best course of action is to either call Joey the mechanic on the phone to get your car back to you. You can also use the RydeMe App to get wherever you need to go. Jason's vehicles can never be lost permanently, so don't worry too much about ditching those in the first part of GTA 6.
